name: BD Tax & Accounting Services
what_they_do: Tax and accounting practice offering financial/business advisory, bookkeeping, payroll, personal and business tax preparation and consulting, business startups, licences and permits, ITIN applications, notary, audit support and IRS negotiations. Positions itself as a bilingual, internationally experienced firm helping small businesses.
customers: Small and mid-sized business owners and individuals, with a strong Spanish-speaking/immigrant clientele (ITIN service, Spanish testimonials, international experience).

size_signals.signal: Homepage claims 'Employing over 200 employees in 14 countries' (inference: likely a network/partner claim or template copy - unverified and inconsistent with a single New Brunswick storefront office)
Site states '10 years of professional tax experience on the international level'; footer credits 'Geo Digital Agency' - a template-built WordPress site
Two New Brunswick phone numbers listed in the footer and Mon-Fri 10-5 hours

listing.platform: Loc8NearMe directory snapshot of Google listing (Google not viewed directly)

website_review.primary_cta: 'SEE MORE' hero button, 'GET A FREE QUOTE CALCULATION' form and 'Request a call back' form on the homepage
website_review.online_booking_or_quote: Quote-request and call-back forms on the homepage only (no scheduling, no online booking)
website_review.trust_signals: Ten client testimonials on the homepage, ten years' experience claim, service icons, logo; no photos of staff or office, no licences/credentials shown
website_review.out_of_date_signs: Footer reads 'BD TAX Copyright © 2022'; misspellings throughout ('Wendsday', 'BUSSINES', 'coffe'); several linked pages return WordPress 404s
website_review.search_basics: Title does name the town and service ('BDtax - Tax & Accounting Services. New Brunswick, NJ') but the homepage has no meta description and no LocalBusiness JSON-LD; service pages exist as URLs but are broken
top_issues: Nearly every internal page is dead: /contact-us/, /services/, /accounting/, /tax-consulting/, /payroll/, /audit/, /notary-public/, /financial-advisor/ and others all return 'Error 404 - Not found', so the site is effectively a single page with a broken menu.
No click-to-call link, no online booking and no readable price guidance; conversion depends on two homepage forms and a phone number (form fields have almost no labels - 1 label across 4 forms).
Hero headline says 'FINANCIAL & BUSINESS ADVISOR' rather than tax/accounting in New Brunswick, the site carries no structured data, and the 2022 template footer with typos reads as neglected.

agent_readiness.notes: No robots.txt (404, so crawling is unrestricted by default) and no JSON-LD at all. Hours and address are real text, services exist only on the homepage plus broken subpages. Forms are present but unlabelled, with no schema and no booking - an agent could submit a lead form but not book a time.

operations_signals.signal: Site promises 'one of our expert advisor will get in touch in 24 hours' by form or email - inference: manual, human triage of every enquiry, with a stated 1-day turnaround.
Services span payroll, ITIN, notary, audit and IRS negotiations plus tax season - inference: high document-handling load with no client portal (only email address published).
Ten testimonials praise response time and support rather than price - suggests speed of response is the firm's selling point and would be worth automating.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Rebuild/repair the site: restore the broken service and contact pages, give each service (tax prep, payroll, ITIN, audit, IRS negotiations) a working page with town-level titles, add click-to-call and a labelled intake form.
top_opportunities.evidence: Direct navigation to /contact-us/, /services/, /accounting/, /tax-consulting/, /payroll/, /audit/, /notary-public/, /financial-advisor/ all return 'Error 404 - Not found' while the homepage links to them.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Bilingual (EN/ES) intake and follow-up agent answering tax-season questions, collecting documents via secure upload and booking appointments - replacing the 24-hour call-back promise.
top_opportunities.evidence: Homepage states an advisor will get in touch 'in 24 hours'; only contact routes are unlabelled forms, email and phone.

top_opportunities.opportunity: Add hours, services and price ranges plus LocalBusiness/AccountingService schema so AI assistants can answer and route clients.
top_opportunities.evidence: No JSON-LD on the site and no meta description; hours exist only as footer text.

scores.reasons: Broken navigation across a whole site plus no click-to-call, no booking and no schema is a large, clearly evidenced gap; a small local tax firm has modest but real budget, and fixes are quick to deliver.
